# Where to Watch Guarded Season 2


by Angel | September 8, 2026


The wait is finally over. *Guarded* is back for Season 2, and the questions left hanging after that Season 1 cliffhanger are finally starting to get answers.


After surviving a devastating attack, Jess O’Brien is more determined than ever to uncover who was really behind it. But the deeper she digs, the more complicated the mystery becomes—and the more dangerous it gets.


[Season 2 of Guarded is now streaming on Angel](https://www.angel.com/watch/guarded) **,** with new episodes dropping weekly. Episode 1 is ready to watch now.


### **From Romance to Conspiracy**


Season 1 introduced viewers to Jess and her complicated relationship with billionaire Mason Flynn. What began as a bodyguard assignment became something much more personal, only to take a dangerous turn when an attack changed everything.


Season 2 picks up from that cliffhanger and expands the story beyond romance. Jess is no longer simply trying to understand what happened to her. She’s trying to uncover who orchestrated it—and why.


With secrets, betrayal, unexpected alliances, and an international conspiracy in the mix, the stakes are higher than ever.


### **Ready for More Suspense?**


If you’ve been waiting for answers since the Season 1 finale, you’re not alone. Angel Guild members have made their feelings about the wait pretty clear.


One viewer joked, “I will die if this new episode does not come out,” while another praised the series for its suspense and said, “I love the suspense!” A longtime fan summed up the appeal simply: “It keeps getting better and better!”


### **Watch** ***Guarded*** **Season 2 on Angel**


The Season 1 cliffhanger left plenty of questions. Now, Season 2 is finally ready to start answering them.


**Episode 1 is streaming now on Angel, with new episodes of Guarded dropping weekly.**


Follow Jess as she digs deeper into the conspiracy, gets closer to the truth, and discovers that finding answers may put everything—and everyone she cares about—in danger.


[Start watching Guarded Season 2 now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/guarded)
